name: china-plate
title: 中国车牌解析 China License Plate Parser
description: 中国机动车车牌号码解析与识别。Use when the user provides a Chinese license plate number and wants to identify the province, city, plate type (普通/新能源/军牌/警牌/学牌), or validate its format. Covers all 31 provinces and special plate types. Fully offline — no network, no API key required.
